source_text: Hi sunt reges quos percussit Iesus — catalogus victoriae. Singuli principes vitiorum nominandi et prosternendi.
pass_a_gloss: These are kings whom struck Jesus — catalogue of-victory. Individual princes of-vices to-be-named and laid-low.
pass_b_english: [[These are the kings Jesus struck >> Bible:Joshua 12:7-24]] — a victory catalogue. Each vice’s prince must be named and laid low.
